description: Anvil Rework changes Minecraft 26.2 anvil mechanics: it removes the prior-work penalty and 40-level cost cap, makes renaming and basic repairs free, and charges 1 level per enchantment applied or upgraded. Combining enchanted books costs 1 level, and anvils no longer wear out during normal use. Enchanting-table behavior is unchanged.

mods.name: Anvil Rework
mods.description: Reworks anvil costs, prior work penalties, and durability.
